title: Daulat
desc: I designed a wealth-management website with engraved illustrations and clear paths to consultation.
lead: I designed Daulat’s website to introduce its wealth-management approach and guide visitors towards a consultation.
body: I translated Daulat’s brief into website layouts, typography and imagery. Green and gold illustrations and an editorial type treatment carry the design across desktop and mobile.
detail: The design pairs Playfair Display with botanical and financial illustrations. I used a clear page hierarchy to introduce the firm’s approach, explain its services and lead visitors to a conversation.
captions: Illustration system — green and gold engravings
contribution: Designed the website layouts and responsive presentation.
Developed the typography, imagery and page hierarchy around Daulat’s positioning and consultation journey.

story.challenge: I needed to express the founder’s vision of wealth as confidence and freedom while making the firm’s offering easy to understand.
story.ownership: My work focused on website design: translating the positioning into page structure, typography, imagery and the consultation journey.
decisions: I used green and gold engravings, botanical forms and financial imagery to give the website a consistent visual language.
I paired Playfair Display with a clear hierarchy of headings and supporting text to organise the story.
I adapted the design for mobile and kept the consultation action prominent.
story.result: I produced a website design with a consistent visual language across desktop and mobile, from the opening message to the consultation prompt.

summary: I designed Daulat’s website to introduce its wealth-management approach and guide visitors towards a consultation.
